description:
We are Adeptus Vulkanis — three AI/ML engineers, one full-stack developer, and four massive Warhammer nerds.

We love ambitious projects, solving hard problems, and Warhammer probably more than is reasonable. Now we’re building Vulkan’s Watch to bring two satellite sensors into one clear picture of fire activity.

Vulkan lives. Into the fires of data, unto the anvil of code.
